method: Within each club, use source-led roster pool; assign temporary tactical model and select up to XI starter slots plus one backup by position using descending 1999-00 league starts. CB 2+1; 4-4-2 has two ST, 4-3-3 has two CM, 4-2-3-1 has standalone CAM; no CAM invented for others. Not final since 1999-00 starts-at-position and tactical shifts are unverified. Existing main roster is *not* used to choose candidates; exact-match old records are used only as a secondary DOB/ID cache, clearly identified for rechecking.

clubs.positionCaveat: Positions are working hypotheses (not BDFutbol exact appearance-by-position counts); use match-by-match sources to revise. Some backup candidates are omitted by the cap.
